text:
Robert Thomas is the engine of a St. Louis team that has started scoring in bunches: 8-6 over Anaheim, 9-6 over New Jersey. The Blues captain has 23 points in 23 games, 14 of them in his last ten, and moved into third in assists in franchise history this week.

He is a passer first. Only 31 shots and 5 goals, but Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 10.1 primary shot assists per 60 last season (94th percentile among forwards) and leaving the zone with possession on 79% of his exits. Evolving-Hockey had him as the 20th most valuable forward in 2025-26.

The flag is a big one: the Blues have scored 11.2 more goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice, and that is padding his assist total. The chances themselves are fine, 54.3% of the 5v5 expected goals with him out there, so the point pace should settle rather than collapse. Our range has him at 71 to 97 points.
